_comment: Project MCP servers for the social-automation pipeline. Safe to commit: no secrets inline. Higgsfield uses OAuth (run /mcp in Claude Code to log in). Blotato reads BLOTATO_API_KEY from your environment. See social-automation/config/mcp.example.json and social-automation/.env.example. NOTE: this cloud sandbox network blocks higgsfield.ai, so these connect only on a machine whose network policy allows them (e.g. your own).
